evidence.detail: rs/v/a is a singleton-style Runnable service owning background thread state, socket requests, URL/DataInputStream loading, Runnable dispatch and shared cache-file handles.
Synchronized entry points request sockets against a stored InetAddress and open remote data streams while the service thread serializes those asynchronous operations.
The class owns RandomAccessFile cache handles, cache-directory/name helpers and byte-array save requests used by the client runtime.
It also owns applet/environment state, DNS/reporting strings and utility hooks historically grouped into the classic client signlink bridge.
The combined static service thread, socket/url/thread/cache-file responsibilities match the classic client Signlink architecture; exact v308 behavior is primary authority.

candidates.note: Signlink is the conservative historical/semantic name for the exact v308 platform/network/cache runtime bridge. Exact bytecode behavior is primary evidence.
